hubMedsSubtitle: A gentle medical guide for relieving menstrual cramps safely. Always take painkillers with food and consult your doctor if pain is unusually severe.
med1Desc: Reduces prostaglandins that cause painful uterine muscle contractions. Highly effective at the start of cramps.
med1Tip: 💡 Tip: Always take after a snack or meal.
med2Desc: Gentle on the stomach and very safe for mild to moderate period ache, back stiffness, and headache.
med2Tip: 💡 Tip: Can be combined with warm herbal drinks.
med3Desc: Directly targets and inhibits prostaglandin synthesis in uterine muscles for strong menstrual cramps.
med3Tip: 💡 Tip: Take with a full glass of water.
med4Desc: Offers extended relief from persistent cramps, ideal before sleep or throughout long working hours.
med4Tip: 💡 Tip: Lasts longer than standard ibuprofen.
rem1Desc: Cinnamon relaxes muscle tension, while spearmint soothes hormonal fluctuations gently.
rem2Desc: A warm heating pad placed on the lower abdomen increases blood flow and relaxes pelvic muscles.
rem3Desc: Rich in magnesium and antioxidants, dark chocolate boosts dopamine and reduces cramps naturally.
rem4Desc: Drinking 2-3 liters of warm water reduces water retention, bloating, and fatigue.
